meta.title: Political efficacy
meta.question: Do Poles feel they have a say in politics?
meta.measure: Average sense of political efficacy, from 0 (people like me have no say) to 10 (people like me have a say)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on whether people feel they have a say in and understand politics, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: If the government made a decision you thought wrong, could you do something about it?
items.notes: CDCEE Jan 1991 and Mar 2000. Almond-Verba subjective competence. 'Other' (code 5, 2000) has no position.

items.wording: People like me have no influence on what the government does (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
items.notes: CBOS 1992-03, 1995-09, 1996-01, 1997-06, 4 surveys. 1992 labels 'Zdecydowanie się Pan(i) zgadza ... Czy zdecydowanie się Pan(i) nie zgadza'. The 1999-01 'Zwykli obywatele nie mają wpływu...' (ordinary citizens, one survey) left out.

items.wording: Do people like you have an influence on the affairs of the country?
items.notes: CBOS, 1993-07 to 2016-01, 14 surveys. The local version ('sprawy swojego miasta, gminy') is a different object and is excluded by the regex.

items.wording: People like me have no influence on what the government does (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
It makes a big difference (1) ... no difference at all (5) who is in power
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2019, 7 surveys (CSES 'who is in power makes a difference'). Responsiveness rather than personal efficacy; kept because CSES treats the pair as one battery.

items.wording: Who people vote for makes no difference (1) ... can make a big difference (5)
items.notes: PGSW 1997, 2001, 2007, 2011, 2019, 2023 (CSES 'who people vote for makes a difference').

items.wording: Do you think you could take an active role in a group involved with political issues? (definitely not ... definitely)
How often does politics seem so complicated that you can't really understand what is going on? (never = 10)
How difficult or easy do you find it to make your mind up about political issues?
My voice counts in (our country): tend to agree / tend to disagree
items.notes: Eurobarometer, 2008-2012, 6 surveys (ZA4744, ZA4819, ZA4973, ZA5234, ZA5449, ZA5686): tend to agree / tend to disagree only. Same regex as EB_VOICE_4; the value labels separate them.

items.wording: Politics is so complicated that people do not understand what is happening (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
items.notes: POLPAN 2008 only. Says 'people', not 'people like me'.

items.wording: Voters have too little influence on how the country is governed (agree-disagree; disagree = 10)
Voting gives people like me some say about how the government runs things (agree-disagree)
items.notes: Pew, Polish readings autumn 2009 and 2019 (the regex also matches 2012, when Poland was not asked).

items.wording: My voice counts in (our country): totally agree ... totally disagree
items.notes: Eurobarometer, 2012-2026, 59 surveys ('MY VOICE COUNTS - IN (OUR COUNTRY)' and earlier 'EU STATEMENTS: MY VOICE COUNTS IN COUNTRY'). The EU version and '(OUR COUNTRY) VOICE COUNTS IN EU' are excluded by the regex.

items.wording: How able do you think you are to take an active role in a group involved with political issues? (0-10)
How confident are you in your own ability to participate in politics? (0-10)
How easy is it for you to take part in politics? (0-10)
How much would you say the political system allows people like you to have an influence on politics? (0-10)
How much would you say the political system in Poland allows people like you to have a say in what the government does? (0-10)
As above, 5-point
As above, 5-point
As above, 5-point
As above, 5-point (not at all ... a great deal)
Do people like you have an influence on the affairs of the country? (yes / no)
items.notes: CBOS 2017-07 only: the same question with yes/no answers.

items.wording: I feel I understand the most important political issues facing the country (agree-disagree)
How much influence do you have on important political decisions concerning the state? (online)
items.notes: SWPS COVID tracker wave 13 (online). Influence on decisions about the state; the regional and local items are excluded.

items.wording: Do people like you have an influence on the affairs of the country? (yes/no; CBOS democracy survey 2021)
As above, 5-point
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.
